name: Meyssa
text:
Bike lockers are clear, the broken one got fixed this morning. Number 7 is free again. Tags are on the board.
Thanks,
Meyssa

name: Kscheschinski
text:
The handover board has been wiped and the new sheets are up by the office door. Anything not ticked by Friday gets chased on Monday. Dates for the training round are in the corner.
Thanks,
Kscheschinski

name: Abdelnour Jibril
text:
Quick one: the meeting room clock will be swapped on Thursday so ignore the time on the display until then. The alarm test runs at ten and takes five minutes, no need to leave the floor. Fire doors are being checked in the afternoon, please keep the corridors clear.
Regards,
Abdelnour Jibril

name: Ismailjaki Ellinger
text:
Morning all, the kitchen freezer is being defrosted today so anything you want kept should move to the tall fridge.
Thanks,
Ismailjaki Ellinger

name: Mioara
text:
The quiet room booking sheet has moved online, the link is pinned in the group chat. Paper requests stop at the end of the month. Any clashes will be sorted by the office.
Thanks,
Mioara

name: Mampasi
text:
Reminder that the lift is out for its yearly inspection on Tuesday between nine and one. Use the stairs or the goods lift at the back, the bell on that one is loud so ear defenders are by the door. The notice will go up tonight on every floor.
Thanks,
Mampasi

name: Cetlin Höglinger
text:
The parcel locker code changes tonight, check the app before you leave. Overflows go to reception. Tag anything oversized.
Thanks,
Cetlin Höglinger

name: Gracey Karolyn
text:
The click and collect shelf is full again, so staff orders move to the back of the stockroom until Friday. Labels help. The courier slot is unchanged at four o clock.
Thanks,
Gracey Karolyn

name: Janita
text:
Team, the canteen is running a reduced menu this week while the main oven is rebuilt, so the soup and sandwiches are back. Hot meals return on Monday. Card only at the till, the cash drawer is out for repair. The salad bar stays open all day.
Thanks,
Janita

name: Bernardinello
text:
Water is back on in both blocks, run the taps for a minute first as it may be cloudy.
Thanks,
Bernardinello

name: Fabiënne Idina
text:
The staff car park resurfacing starts Thursday, so park on the road side until the barriers come down. Tickets will be reimbursed. The work is expected to take three days.
Thanks,
Fabiënne Idina

name: Kübra Chrzanowski
text:
Notice for the late shift: the external doors are on a timed lock from tonight, so use your badge to exit as well as enter. The time delay is fifteen seconds. Any faults go in the book. The engineer will check the settings on Friday morning.
Thanks,
Kübra Chrzanowski

name: Tillott
text:
The recycling bins have been swapped for bigger ones, the lids are stiff so press the middle. Collections stay on Tuesday.
Thanks,
Tillott

name: Kristof
text:
Reminder for the hearing check on Thursday at ten past two, it takes about twenty minutes. Take the ear plugs out an hour before and bring the last test sheet if you have it.
Thanks,
Kristof

name: Gammuto
text:
Your physio appointment moves to Wednesday at 4:15 in the annex, same room as last time. Bring the resistance band and wear the flat shoes. The clinic asked for the referral letter to be emailed before the visit, the address is on their site. Parking is free for the first hour.
Thanks,
Gammuto

name: Redur Maugweiler Fauve
text:
Dental check Friday at 9:20, arrive early for the new patient form. Bring the list of medications.
Thanks,
Redur Maugweiler Fauve

name: Sazan Ljepa
text:
Scan appointment Tuesday at 8:40, radiology, ground floor. Fasting from ten tonight and only water in the morning. Take the proof of address letter. The department will text if the slot changes.
Thanks,
Sazan Ljepa

name: Ashvinth
text:
Speech therapy for the little one moves to Thursday at 3:30 in the community wing. Take the picture cards and the progress folder, the therapist will want the latest notes. Sessions run for forty minutes with the last ten minutes for parents. The waiting room has a toy box.
Thanks,
Ashvinth

name: Hagendorn
text:
The boiler service is Wednesday morning, so empty the cupboard beneath the kitchen sink before the engineer arrives. He needs a clear run at the valve.
Thanks,
Hagendorn

name: Rominga Leko
text:
Eye test moved to Monday at 11:10 in the market square branch. Take the old frames even if the lenses are scratched, they get measured for comparison. The test takes half an hour.
Thanks,
Rominga Leko

name: Davey Bleuel
text:
Colonoscopy prep reminder, two sachets from the pharmacy and no solid food after midday on Wednesday. Clear drinks only through the afternoon. The unit calls to confirm the arrival time, keep the phone on. Water is fine right up to midnight. The prep sheet is on the fridge.
Thanks,
Davey Bleuel

name: Bedrije
text:
Piano tuning moved to Friday 3pm, keep the room quiet for the hour and leave the windows shut.
Thanks,
Bedrije

name: Haussmann
text:
Chimney sweep confirmed for Monday between nine and one, clear the fireplace and move the logs outside. The van needs a clear driveway. He rings the bell before starting and wears covers.
Thanks,
Haussmann

name: Joram Zmeková
text:
Oven repair visit Thursday, the engineer needs the power off at the isolator before he arrives. Empty the bottom drawer and put the racks somewhere safe. The part is already loaded so it should be done in one visit. Company texted the two hour window, it is on the fridge.
Thanks,
Joram Zmeková

name: Antonella Enedina
text:
Podiatry Thursday, half one in the annex, bring the inserts and the old prescription for review. Expect thirty minutes with the shoe check.
Thanks,
Antonella Enedina

name: Gözübüyük
text:
Midwife appointment Wednesday at 10:20, up at the community hub. Bring the maternity notes and the sample bottle. The car park behind the hub has free spaces for an hour. The reception likes a text if you are late.
Thanks,
Gözübüyük

name: Jennifer
text: Jennifer the rota is up and you have the quiet slots this week, so if anyone asks about swaps point them at the sheet on the door. The new girl starts Monday and needs a walk through the till before the lunch rush. Tea stock is in the back.

name: Beckereit
text: Beckereit the box of blue gloves went to the wrong shelf again, can you move it back over by the sinks before the inspection.

name: Gonik Pical
text: Gonik Pical the late delivery from Thursday is still on the pallet by the shutter, can you check the labels against the manifest and book it in before the stock count.

name: Del Vratislav
text: Del Vratislav the desk lamp in the front office flickers when the printer kicks in, so i moved it to the other socket and it has been fine since. If it starts again we will need an electrician. The spare bulbs are in the filing cabinet.

name: Claude-Eric
text: Claude-Eric the shared drive is nearly full again, can you clear the old video folder before the audit next week.

name: Benhima
text: Benhima the visitor badges are running low and the lanyards are down to the last few, can you order both before the open day rush starts. The order form is in the top drawer, delivery takes two days.

name: Stavri Lipperini
text: Stavri Lipperini the fridge log has two gaps from the weekend, can you fill them in from the temperature chart on the wall. The auditor only wants to see the numbers and initials, no long notes. The chart itself stays up until the end of the month.

name: Celine Jiayi
text: Celine Jiayi the microwave in the break room sparks when the door is open, dont use it until maintenance swaps it.

name: Marija-Magdalena
text: Marija-Magdalena the parcel for the second floor was signed under your name by mistake, can you log it as received so the tracker clears. The boxes are in the cage. I put a note on the door.

name: Nezirevic
text: Nezirevic the training room projector keeps losing the signal mid presentation, the cable has been swapped once already. If it drops again tomorrow we will use the screen in the hall. The board is booked either way so the slot is covered. A spare dongle lives in the drawer.

name: De Amicis
text: De Amicis the fire door on the east side is being checked tomorrow morning, keep the corridor clear from nine.

name: Pirabaharan Keng
text: Pirabaharan Keng the sandwich order for the meeting went to the wrong room, can you grab it from reception before it goes cold. The client has not arrived yet. Eat yours after the handover.

name: Kristiyan
text: Kristiyan your dental cleaning is Thursday at quarter past eleven with the hygienist, and arrive ten minutes early to fill in the paperwork. Take the insurance card and the referral letter that was missed last time. The practice has moved to the corner unit by the pharmacy. Parking is behind the building.

name: Reißig
text: Reißig your blood test moved to Friday 8:10 upstairs in the treatment room, no fasting needed this time round. Take the yellow referral form.

name: Carl Pârvu
text: Carl Pârvu your allergy shot is Friday morning at quarter past nine in room 3B. Nothing to eat in the two hours beforehand and bring the antihistamine list. The nurse checks it first. The booster is due in six months.

name: Tiranti Gauffriau
text: Tiranti Gauffriau your driving assessment is Tuesday at 10, meet the instructor at the test centre gate. Take both parts of the licence and wear sensible shoes. The car is automatic and the route covers town and dual carriageway. Results come by email within two working days.

name: Ilia
text: Ilia your flu jab is Saturday morning at the village hall, take the blue card along and wear something with short sleeves.

name: Rasia
text: Rasia your car service is Friday, drop the keys at seven so the loan van stays free for the school run. Leave the barrier fobs and the parking pass in the glovebox. The garage confirmed the slot this morning.

name: Numa Arment
text: Numa Arment your viewing at the flat on Mill Lane is now Sunday midday, meet the agent at the front gate. The keys are with the agency on the high street. Take a torch for the cellar and note the meter readings while you are there.

name: Bonaria Rauner
text: Bonaria Rauner your hearing test is Thursday at 3 at the audiology clinic, bring the noise exposure paperwork the office sent round.

name: Lizzy
text: Lizzy your bank review is Thursday at 10:30 at the branch on High Street, take the mortgage statement and proof of the salary raise. The advisor asked for the documents in advance if possible.

name: Aljaf
text: Aljaf your prep for the colonoscopy begins Wednesday, two sachets from the pharmacy, one mid afternoon and one at nine. No solid food after lunch and clear drinks only. The unit rings with the check-in slot. Keep the phone on and take the whole day off work.

name: Nosova Santeiro
text: Nosova Santeiro your ultrasound is Tuesday at 3:40 in the radiology wing, sip water through the morning and keep your bladder full.

name: von der Mühll
text: von der Mühll your deep clean at the dentist is Monday 9:40, take the mouthguard and the sensitivity list for the hygienist. The appointment takes about half an hour. Check in at the desk when you arrive.
